entities.name: Query RibBA
observations: 407 aa fusion protein with N-terminal DHBP_synthase domain (PF00926; residues 13-202) and C-terminal GTP_cyclohydro2 domain (PF00925; residues 212-379).
Homologs C5D3N0, A9VG50, and Q818X6 are reviewed RibBA proteins with 56.6-58.3% identity, 97.3% query coverage, and E-values of 1.6e-155 to 9.18e-155.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is 44,745.9 Da and predicted pI is 5.67.
Functional assignment is supported by strong homology and domain architecture, but exact activity is not directly experimentally established for this query sequence.

entities.name: RibBA
observations: Bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis enzyme comprising 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone-4-phosphate synthase and GTP cyclohydrolase II activities.
Curated homolog annotations assign EC 4.1.99.12 and EC 3.5.4.25.
Curated homologs bind two Mg2+ or Mn2+ ions per subunit and one Zn2+ ion per subunit.
Localized to the cytosol in annotated homologs and participates in riboflavin biosynthesis.

entities.name: RibBA DHBP synthase reaction
observations: D-ribulose 5-phosphate is converted to (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate, also called 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate, plus formate and H+.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:18457 and corresponds to EC 4.1.99.12.

entities.name: RibBA GTP cyclohydrolase II reaction
observations: GTP is converted with water to 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine, formate, inorganic phosphate, and protons; the product is also described as DARP or 2,5-diamino-6-ribosylamino-4(3H)-pyrimidinone 5-prime-phosphate.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:23704 and corresponds to EC 3.5.4.25.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA contributes the initial DHBP synthase branch from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and the initial GTP cyclohydrolase II branch in riboflavin biosynthesis.
